name: Urbana Studios
summary: A property management platform for apartment availability, tenants, contracts, rent payments, invoicing, visit scheduling, and occupancy analytics.
functions: Centralizes units and availability, tenants and contracts, rent payments, invoicing, prospect appointments, and income and occupancy analytics.
problem: The company needed one professional system to manage apartments, leases, tenants, rent collection, and billing while making it easier for prospects to schedule property visits.
solution: I developed a React and Node.js platform with a premium dark interface, an interactive appointment calendar, and a complete administrative panel for the leasing and sales team.

demo.title: Private production system
demo.description: Public access is unavailable because the platform contains confidential tenant, contract, payment, billing, and property data.
